```{r setup}
library(reach.postproc)
library(data.table)
```

The package represents AR coefficients as an `ARParameterSet`. It then derives characteristic roots, forecasts and quality assessments through S7 dispatch.

```{r}
parameters <- default_ar_parameters()
root_information <- roots(parameters)
assessment <- assess(parameters)
forecast <- forecast_ar(
  parameters,
  initial_errors = c(0.20, 0.15, 0.10),
  steps = 480L
)
```

Every tabular result is a `data.table`.

```{r}
root_information@table
assessment@tests
forecast@series
```

The complete executable walkthrough is installed at `inst/examples/01_arma_walkthrough.R`.
